/**
 * Audit Logger.
 * Immutable, event-driven audit trail for compliance and security.
 * Uses the global event bus from Phase 4.
 *
 * All actions are logged with:
 *   - Who (user ID)
 *   - What (action)
 *   - When (timestamp)
 *   - Where (tenant, IP, user agent)
 *   - Result (success/failure)
 */
import { MiddlewareFn } from '@axiljs/common';
export interface AuditEvent {
    action: string;
    actor: {
        id: string | number;
        type: 'user' | 'system' | 'api';
    };
    tenantId?: string;
    target?: {
        type: string;
        id: string | number;
    };
    metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
    ip?: string;
    userAgent?: string;
    success: boolean;
    error?: string;
    timestamp: string;
}
/**
 * Log an auditable event on the global event bus.
 * Subscribers can persist these to a database, S3, or WORM storage.
 */
export declare function auditLog(event: Omit<AuditEvent, 'timestamp'>): void;
/**
 * Middleware that automatically audits all HTTP requests.
 * Attach globally or per-route.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   app.use(auditMiddleware())
 */
export declare function auditMiddleware(): MiddlewareFn;

/**
 * Audit Logger.
 * Immutable, event-driven audit trail for compliance and security.
 * Uses the global event bus from Phase 4.
 *
 * All actions are logged with:
 *   - Who (user ID)
 *   - What (action)
 *   - When (timestamp)
 *   - Where (tenant, IP, user agent)
 *   - Result (success/failure)
 */

import { getGlobalEventBus } from '@axiljs/events';
import { MiddlewareFn }      from '@axiljs/common';

// ─── Audit Event ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface AuditEvent {
  action:    string;
  actor: {
    id:   string | number;
    type: 'user' | 'system' | 'api';
  };
  tenantId?:  string;
  target?: {
    type: string;
    id:   string | number;
  };
  metadata:   Record<string, unknown>;
  ip?:        string;
  userAgent?: string;
  success:    boolean;
  error?:     string;
  timestamp:  string;
}

// ─── auditLog ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Log an auditable event on the global event bus.
 * Subscribers can persist these to a database, S3, or WORM storage.
 */
export function auditLog(event: Omit<AuditEvent, 'timestamp'>): void {
  const fullEvent: AuditEvent = {
    ...event,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  // Emit on global event bus — any subscriber can persist it
  getGlobalEventBus().emit('audit.log', fullEvent);

  console.log(
    `\x1b[90m[AUDIT]\x1b[0m ${fullEvent.actor.id} ` +
    `${fullEvent.action} ` +
    `${fullEvent.success ? '\x1b[32m✓\x1b[0m' : '\x1b[31m✗\x1b[0m'}`
  );
}

// ─── auditMiddleware ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Middleware that automatically audits all HTTP requests.
 * Attach globally or per-route.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   app.use(auditMiddleware())
 */
export function auditMiddleware(): MiddlewareFn {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    const start       = Date.now();
    const originalEnd = (res.raw as any).end.bind(res.raw);

    (res.raw as any).end = function (...args: any[]) {
      const duration = Date.now() - start;
      const user     = (req.locals as any)?.user;
      const tenant   = (req.locals as any)?.tenant;

      auditLog({
        action: `${req.method} ${req.path}`,
        actor:  user
          ? { id: user.id, type: 'user' }
          : { id: 'anonymous', type: 'api' },
        tenantId: tenant?.id,
        metadata: {
          method:     req.method,
          path:       req.path,
          durationMs: duration,
          statusCode: res.raw.statusCode
        },
        ip:        req.ip,
        userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'] as string,
        success:   res.raw.statusCode < 400,
        error:     res.raw.statusCode >= 400
          ? `HTTP ${res.raw.statusCode}`
          : undefined
      });

      return originalEnd(...args);
    };

    next();
  };
}

/**
 * Monitoring Dashboard.
 * Simple HTML dashboard showing live metrics, logs, and health.
 * Served at /dashboard.
 */

import { RouteHandler } from '@axiljs/common';
import { MetricsRegistry } from '@axiljs/observability';

export function createDashboard(registry: MetricsRegistry): RouteHandler {
  return (req, res) => {
    const html = `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <title>@axiljsJS Dashboard</title>
  <style>
    body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0; padding: 20px; background: #0f172a; color: #e2e8f0; }
    h1 { color: #60a5fa; }
    .card { background: #1e2937; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .metric { font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: bold; color: #22c55e; }
    pre { background: #0f172a; padding: 15px; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <h1>@axiljsJS Monitoring Dashboard</h1>
  <div class="card">
    <h2>Live Metrics</h2>
    <pre id="metrics">${registry.toPrometheus()}</pre>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h2>Health Status</h2>
    <div id="health">Loading...</div>
  </div>
  <script>
    setInterval(() => {
      fetch('/metrics').then(r => r.text()).then(t => {
        document.getElementById('metrics').textContent = t;
      });
      fetch('/health').then(r => r.json()).then(d => {
        document.getElementById('health').innerHTML = 
          '<b>Status:</b> ' + d.status + '<br>' +
          '<b>Uptime:</b> ' + d.uptime + 's';
      });
    }, 3000);
  </script>
</body>
</html>`;
    res.html(html);
  };
}

/**
 * Deployment Toolkit.
 * Generates Dockerfiles, Kubernetes manifests, and deployment scripts.
 * Supports `@axiljs deploy` command.
 */

import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'fs';
import { join } from 'path';

export interface DeploymentConfig {
  appName: string;
  version: string;
  port: number;
  replicas?: number;
  domain?: string;
  env?: Record<string, string>;
  cloud?: 'aws' | 'azure' | 'gcp' | 'k8s';
}

export function generateDeployment(config: DeploymentConfig): void {
  const dir = './deploy';
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });

  // Dockerfile
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'Dockerfile'), `FROM node:20-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --production
COPY dist ./dist
EXPOSE ${config.port}
CMD ["node", "dist/main.js"]
`);

  // Kubernetes Deployment
  const k8s = `apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ${config.appName}
spec:
  replicas: ${config.replicas || 3}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ${config.appName}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ${config.appName}
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ${config.appName}
        image: ${config.appName}:${config.version}
        ports:
        - containerPort: ${config.port}
        env:
${Object.entries(config.env || {}).map(([k, v]) => `        - name: ${k}\n          value: "${v}"`).join('\n')}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ${config.appName}
spec:
  selector:
    app: ${config.appName}
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: ${config.port}
`;

  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'deployment.yaml'), k8s);

  // Deployment script
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'deploy.sh'), `#!/bin/bash
echo "Building ${config.appName}:${config.version}..."
docker build -t ${config.appName}:${config.version} .
echo "Pushing to registry..."
docker tag ${config.appName}:${config.version} registry.example.com/${config.appName}:${config.version}
docker push registry.example.com/${config.appName}:${config.version}
echo "Applying Kubernetes manifests..."
kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml
echo "Deployment complete."
`);

  console.log(`\x1b[32m[@axiljsJS Deploy]\x1b[0m Generated deployment files in ./${dir}/`);
}

/**
 * Feature Flags System.
 * Runtime feature toggles with tenant/user scoping.
 *
 * Supports:
 *   - Global flags
 *   - Tenant-specific overrides
 *   - User-specific overrides
 *   - Percentage rollouts
 *   - Scheduled activation
 */
export interface FeatureFlag {
    name: string;
    enabled: boolean;
    description?: string;
    rolloutPercentage?: number;
    allowedTenants?: string[];
    allowedUsers?: (string | number)[];
    expiresAt?: string;
}
export declare class FeatureFlagManager {
    private flags;
    /**
     * Define or update a feature flag.
     */
    define(flag: FeatureFlag): void;
    /**
     * Check if a feature is enabled for this context.
     */
    isEnabled(name: string, context?: {
        tenantId?: string;
        userId?: string | number;
        percentage?: number;
    }): boolean;
    /**
     * Get all flags (for admin UI).
     */
    getAll(): FeatureFlag[];
}
export declare const featureFlags: FeatureFlagManager;
//# sourceMappingURL=feature-flags.d.ts.map

# FILE: C:\Users\Tariq Mehmood\OneDrive\Desktop\AxilJS\packages\cloud\src\feature-flags.ts
####################################################################################################

/**
 * Feature Flags System.
 * Runtime feature toggles with tenant/user scoping.
 *
 * Supports:
 *   - Global flags
 *   - Tenant-specific overrides
 *   - User-specific overrides
 *   - Percentage rollouts
 *   - Scheduled activation
 */

export interface FeatureFlag {
  name: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  description?: string;
  rolloutPercentage?: number;   // 0-100
  allowedTenants?: string[];
  allowedUsers?: (string | number)[];
  expiresAt?: string;
}

export class FeatureFlagManager {
  private flags = new Map<string, FeatureFlag>();

  /**
   * Define or update a feature flag.
   */
  define(flag: FeatureFlag): void {
    this.flags.set(flag.name, { ...flag, rolloutPercentage: flag.rolloutPercentage ?? 100 });
  }

  /**
   * Check if a feature is enabled for this context.
   */
  isEnabled(
    name: string,
    context: {
      tenantId?: string;
      userId?: string | number;
      percentage?: number;   // for A/B testing simulation
    } = {}
  ): boolean {
    const flag = this.flags.get(name);
    if (!flag) return false;
    if (!flag.enabled) return false;

    // Check expiry
    if (flag.expiresAt && new Date(flag.expiresAt) < new Date()) {
      return false;
    }

    // Tenant @axiljsriction
    if (flag.allowedTenants && context.tenantId) {
      if (!flag.allowedTenants.includes(context.tenantId)) return false;
    }

    // User @axiljsriction
    if (flag.allowedUsers && context.userId) {
      if (!flag.allowedUsers.includes(context.userId)) return false;
    }

    // Percentage rollout
    if (flag.rolloutPercentage !== 100 && context.percentage !== undefined) {
      return context.percentage <= flag.rolloutPercentage!;
    }

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Get all flags (for admin UI).
   */
  getAll(): FeatureFlag[] {
    return Array.from(this.flags.values());
  }
}

// Global singleton
export const featureFlags = new FeatureFlagManager();

/**
 * Multi-Tenancy Middleware.
 * Isolates data and configuration per tenant.
 * Supports header, subdomain, or JWT-based tenant resolution.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   app.use(multiTenancy({ strategy: 'header' }))
 *   // req.locals.tenant = { id: 'acme-corp', name: 'Acme Corp' }
 */
import { MiddlewareFn } from '@axiljs/common';
export type TenantResolutionStrategy = 'header' | 'subdomain' | 'jwt';
export interface Tenant {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    plan?: 'free' | 'pro' | 'enterprise';
    [key: string]: unknown;
}
export interface MultiTenancyOptions {
    strategy?: TenantResolutionStrategy;
    headerName?: string;
    resolveTenant?: (tenantId: string) => Promise<Tenant | null>;
    required?: boolean;
}
/**
 * Create multi-tenancy middleware.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   app.use(multiTenancy({ strategy: 'header' }))
 *   app.use(multiTenancy({ strategy: 'subdomain' }))
 *   app.use(multiTenancy({
 *     strategy: 'header',
 *     resolveTenant: async (id) => await db.findTenant(id)
 *   }))
 */
export declare function multiTenancy(options?: MultiTenancyOptions): MiddlewareFn;
/**
 * Get current tenant from request locals.
 * Throws UnauthorizedError if no tenant is present.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const tenant = getTenant(req)
 *   console.log(tenant.id)
 */
export declare function getTenant(req: any): Tenant;

####################################################################################################

/**
 * Multi-Tenancy Middleware.
 * Isolates data and configuration per tenant.
 * Supports header, subdomain, or JWT-based tenant resolution.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   app.use(multiTenancy({ strategy: 'header' }))
 *   // req.locals.tenant = { id: 'acme-corp', name: 'Acme Corp' }
 */

import { MiddlewareFn, UnauthorizedError } from '@axiljs/common';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type TenantResolutionStrategy = 'header' | 'subdomain' | 'jwt';

export interface Tenant {
  id:    string;
  name:  string;
  plan?: 'free' | 'pro' | 'enterprise';
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

export interface MultiTenancyOptions {
  // Strategy to determine tenant (default: 'header')
  strategy?: TenantResolutionStrategy;

  // Header name when using 'header' strategy (default: 'x-tenant-id')
  headerName?: string;

  // Resolve tenant from ID — database lookup, cache, etc.
  // Default: returns a simple object with the ID
  resolveTenant?: (tenantId: string) => Promise<Tenant | null>;

  // Whether a tenant is required (default: true)
  required?: boolean;
}

// ─── multiTenancy ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Create multi-tenancy middleware.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   app.use(multiTenancy({ strategy: 'header' }))
 *   app.use(multiTenancy({ strategy: 'subdomain' }))
 *   app.use(multiTenancy({
 *     strategy: 'header',
 *     resolveTenant: async (id) => await db.findTenant(id)
 *   }))
 */
export function multiTenancy(options: MultiTenancyOptions = {}): MiddlewareFn {
  const {
    strategy       = 'header',
    headerName     = 'x-tenant-id',
    resolveTenant  = async (id: string) => ({ id, name: `Tenant ${id}` }),
    required       = true
  } = options;

  return async (req, res, next) => {
    let tenantId: string | null = null;

    switch (strategy) {

      case 'header':
        // Read tenant ID from a request header
        tenantId = (req.headers[headerName] as string) || null;
        break;

      case 'subdomain': {
        // Extract first subdomain segment from Host header
        const host = req.headers['host'] as string || '';
        const parts = host.split('.');
        // Only treat it as a subdomain if host has at least 2 segments
        tenantId = parts.length >= 2 ? (parts[0] || null) : null;
        break;
      }

      case 'jwt':
        // Extract tenantId from JWT payload (already decoded by authenticate())
        tenantId = (req.locals as any)?.user?.tenantId || null;
        break;
    }

    // No tenant identified
    if (!tenantId) {
      if (required) {
        return next(
          new UnauthorizedError(
            `Tenant identification required. ` +
            `Send the ${headerName} header.`
          )
        );
      }
      return next();
    }

    // Resolve tenant object
    try {
      const tenant = await resolveTenant(tenantId);

      if (!tenant && required) {
        return next(new UnauthorizedError(`Invalid tenant: ${tenantId}`));
      }

      // Attach to request locals
      (req.locals as any).tenant = tenant || { id: tenantId, name: 'Unknown' };

      next();
    } catch (error) {
      next(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error)));
    }
  };
}

// ─── getTenant ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Get current tenant from request locals.
 * Throws UnauthorizedError if no tenant is present.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const tenant = getTenant(req)
 *   console.log(tenant.id)
 */
export function getTenant(req: any): Tenant {
  const tenant = (req.locals as any)?.tenant as Tenant | undefined;

  if (!tenant) {
    throw new UnauthorizedError(
      'No tenant context. ' +
      'Make sure multiTenancy() middleware is applied.'
    );
  }

  return tenant;
}
